faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Science Education and Research Bhubaneswar (NISER) for hiring eligible candidates on a temporary research position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NISER?
faq.answer: NISER has advertised for the post of Junior Research Fellow under the research field with advertisement number NISER / R&D-326 / CH2601 / 24 / 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in the department of Chemistry at NISER Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Chemistry along with a valid National Eligibility Test score such as CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship or a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as on 10.10.2026. Age relaxation is applicable to entitled categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary or stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a monthly stipend of ₹37,000/- plus HRA as per the applicable rules of the institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled-in application along with scanned copies of relevant certificates via email is 10-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM IST.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates must send their complete bio-data and documents to the designated email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The online interview through Google Meet for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 14-10-2026 after initial verification of applications.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial verification of applications and certificates sent via email, followed by an online interview conducted through Google Meet.
